items.stem: 다음 대화에서 밑줄 친 that sign이 뜻하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
B: May I go to the video room, Mom?
W: Of course, but don't run.
B: Why not?
W: Look at <u>that sign</u>. You must not run inside the museum.
items.explain: You must not run inside the museum. → 뛰지 마시오.

items.stem: A와 B의 대화가 어색한 것은?
choices:
A: Mr. Lee, may I drink water in class?
B: Yes, you may.

A: May I take food into the museum?
B: No, you may not. You must not bring any food inside.

A: Excuse me, but you must not talk on the phone here.
B: I'm terribly sorry. I'll turn off my phone.

A: Can you please close the door? The air conditioner is on.
B: Oh, I didn't know that. I'll close it right away.

A: May I go to the video room, Mom?
B: Of course, but you must not go there.
items.explain: Of course.(허락) 뒤에 must not go there(금지)가 와서 모순.

items.stem: 주어진 우리말을 영작한 문장으로 어법상 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box: 나는 매일 저녁 친구들과 전화로 이야기하는 것을 좋아해.
choices: I like talk on the phone with my friends every evening.
I like to talking on the phone with my friends every evening.
I like to talk on phone with my friends every evening.
I like to talk on the phone with my friends every evening.
I like to talk in the phone with my friends every evening.
items.explain: like + to부정사, 숙어 talk on the phone.

items.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 단어는?
items.box:
The paint is starting to fall ________ the wall.
He fell ________ the ladder and hurt his legs.
items.explain: fall off ~: ~에서 떨어지다.
items.source: 학습지 L5 Advanced C-3 · Workbook B-5

items.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
items.box:
A: Is Sora faster than you?
B: Yes, she is. ______________________________
choices: She is fastest runner of my class.
She is the fastest runner in my class.
She is the most fast runner in my class.
She is the faster runner of my class.
She is the most fastest runner in my class.
items.explain: the + 최상급 + in + 집단.

items.stem: 다음 단어에 대한 영어 뜻풀이로 적절하지 않은 것은?
choices: eyewitness: a person who saw something happen, for example, a crime or an accident
suspect: someone who is thought to be guilty of a crime
bakery: a shop where bread and cakes are sold
janitor: a person in charge of cleaning and fixing things in a building
wheelchair: a chair with wheels, used by people who can run fast
items.explain: wheelchair: used by people who cannot walk.

items.stem: 다음은 단어와 영어 뜻풀이를 작성한 것이다. 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
items.box:
leftover: food ________ after a meal
recycle: to use something ________ to make something new
container: something that you ________ things in
challenge: a difficult task or ________
items.explain: remaining / again / keep / problem 순서로 들어간다.

items.stem: 다음 문장의 의미상 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 없는 단어는?
items.box:
We should ________ waste.
I can ________ a button on my shirt.
The pizza ________ arrived on time.
He took off the ________ from the bottle.
items.explain: reduce / sew / delivery / label.

items.stem: 글의 흐름상 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
items.box: Minho's house has three floors. On the first floor, there ⓐ[is/are] a living room. On the second floor, there ⓑ[is/are] two bedrooms. Lastly, on the third floor, there is a gym. It ⓒ[is/are] the biggest of all the rooms.
items.explain: a living room(단수) → is, two bedrooms(복수) → are, It → is.

items.stem: 우리말 해석에 맞는 문장을 영작할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지와 다른 하나는?
choices:
There ________ pandas in the zoo.
동물원에 판다들이 있다.

There ________ not many books on the shelf.
선반에 책이 많지 않다.

There ________ a lot of people on the subway.
지하철에 많은 사람들이 있다.

There ________ some students in the library.
도서관에 몇몇 학생들이 있다.

There ________ some water in the bottle.
병 안에 약간의 물이 있다.
items.explain: water는 셀 수 없는 명사 → is. 나머지는 are.

items.stem: 문장에서 밑줄 친 단어의 의미가 알맞지 않은 것은?
choices: I <u>remember</u> my first day of school. (기억하다)
The movie starts with a scary <u>scene</u>. (장면)
The leaves turned <u>golden</u> in the autumn. (황금빛의)
Would you like to have a <u>piece</u> of cake for dessert? (접시)
items.explain: piece: 조각.

items.box:
A: I'm so hungry, but there's no food at home.
B: I know. (A) ______________________
A: I'm sorry, but I don't want to go out now. Can you please go to a restaurant and pick up some food?
B: Sure. No problem.

items.stem: 위 대화의 흐름상 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: I'll make a sandwich for you.
items.explain: 뒤에서 A가 나가고 싶지 않다고 했으므로 외식 제안.

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: A wants to go out for dinner.
There is a lot of food at home.
A will go to the restaurant.
items.explain: B가 외식을 제안했고, 음식을 가져오는 부탁을 들어준다.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 하나는?
choices: I plan <u>to</u> travel around Spain this summer.
We walked <u>to</u> the park right after lunch.
My goal is <u>to</u> learn skiing this winter.
items.explain: ④는 전치사 to, 나머지는 to부정사.

lines: Last Saturday, someone threw a cake at the Monalisa in the Botero Museum in Bogota, Colombia. There were four eyewitnesses. What did they say? Read the following, and find the criminal.

I was looking at the Monalisa, and someone threw a cake at the painting. I turned around and saw an old man. (A) He was standing in front of a wheelchair. I'm about 170 cm tall, and ⓐ<u>he</u> was a little taller than me.

An old man with gray hair (가)<u>was running away</u>, and something (나)<u>fell off</u> his head. (B) It was his wig. I ran after ⓑ<u>him</u>, but I couldn't catch him. He was (다)<u>more faster than me</u>. In fact, the old man was not old. ⓒ<u>He</u> was a young man with long brown hair.
I went to the crime scene, and (라)<u>there were pieces of cake</u> all over the painting. (C) There was also a wheelchair near the painting, and I found a cake box next to the wheelchair. (D)
Camila Santos, the owner of Camila's Bakery

Last Friday, ⓓ<u>a young man</u> came in. I spoke to him in Spanish, but he didn't understand ⓔ<u>me</u>. He spoke only English. (E) We had a lot of different cakes, but he just wanted (마)<u>the most smallest one</u>. We sold only one cake that day, (바)<u>so I remember him clearly</u>. Oh, he had blue eyes.

items.stem: 윗글의 (A)~(E) 중 문맥상 주어진 문장이 들어갈 곳으로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box: The box was from Camila's Bakery.
items.explain: cake box를 발견한 직후 (D).

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 가리키는 대상이 다른 하나는?
items.explain: ⓐ~ⓓ는 범인(젊은 남자), ⓔ는 Camila.

items.stem: 윗글을 읽고 대답을 찾을 수 없는 질문은?
choices: What fell off the old man's head?
How many cakes did Camila's Bakery sell last Friday?
What color were the young man's eyes?
How old was the young man?
items.explain: 나이는 나오지 않는다.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 (가)~(바) 중 문맥상, 어법상 옳은 것을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
items.explain: (다) more faster → faster, (마) the most smallest → the smallest.

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것은?
items.box: She ________ to learn Spanish this winter.
items.explain: enjoy는 동명사를 목적어로 취한다.

items.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 that을 생략할 수 없는 것은?
choices: I think <u>that</u> the movie is interesting.
We hope <u>that</u> you will come to the party.
items.explain: ④는 지시대명사 that. 나머지는 목적어절을 이끄는 접속사 that(생략 가능).

items.stem: 밑줄 친 말에 담긴 의도로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
M: <u>Can you please carry this box to my car?</u>
G: I'm really sorry, Dad, but I'm late for my class.
M: Oh, I see. I'll ask somebody else.
items.explain: Can you please ~?: 부탁.

lines: Domingo: My dog tore my bag. I wanted to buy a new one, but I thought again. I learned that reusing is important for zero-waste living. So, (A)<u>나는 그것을 수선해서 재사용하기로 결심했어.</u> I'm not very good at sewing, and I don't think that the bag looks perfect. I guess it's all right.

Emma: I often use food delivery services, but today I didn't. Instead, I walked to my favorite restaurant with a reusable ⓐ<u>container</u> and picked up the food. I heard that plastic never goes away completely. I didn't use any single-use plastic today. I felt good!

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)를 어법상 옳은 영어 문장으로 작성한 것은?
choices: I decided fix it and reuse it.
I decided to fix it and reuse it.
I decided fixing it and reusing it.
I decided to fixed it and reused it.
I decide to fix it and to reusing it.
items.explain: decide + to부정사, and로 동사원형 병렬.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 영어 뜻풀이로 알맞은 것은?
choices: something that you keep things in
the act of bringing goods to a particular person or place
items.explain: container: 용기.

items.stem: 윗글의 (B)에 들어갈 소제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 찢어진 가방을 고쳐 다시 쓰는 이야기.

items.stem: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
items.box:
To eat breakfast is good for the health.
He decided quit his job.
I know that he reads books in the library now.
I don't think will she talk with Minsu.
She loves to play the piano.
They enjoyed to solve puzzles.
I really hope seeing them again.
items.explain: 옳은 것: 1·3·5. decided to quit / that she will talk / enjoyed solving / hope to see.

items.stem: 글을 읽고 질문에 대한 답을 글에서 찾아 7단어로 이루어진 하나의 영어 문장으로 작성하시오.

lines: Olivia: My birthday was last Saturday, and my family and I ate out. There were lots of leftovers, but we brought them home. The next day, I made a nice lunch out of them. FYI, you can find great cooking ideas for leftovers on the Internet.
질문: Olivia, where can you find great cooking ideas for leftovers?

items.answer: I can find them on the Internet.
items.explain: 7단어. them = great cooking ideas for leftovers.

items.stem: 대화의 밑줄 친 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 조건에 맞는 영어 문장을 작성하시오.
items.box:
W: Excuse me, but <u>문을 닫아 주시겠어요?</u> The air conditioner is on.
B: Oh, I didn't know that. I'll close it right away.
W: Thanks.
items.answer: Can you please close the door?
items.explain: 부탁 표현 Can you please + 동사원형 ~?

items.stem: 주어진 모든 단어를 한 번씩만 사용하여 알맞은 순서로 배열하고 우리말 뜻과 일치하는 문장을 작성하시오.
items.box:
나는 그 가방이 완벽해 보인다고 생각하지 않는다.
( think / I / that / the bag / looks / don't / perfect )
items.answer: I don't think that the bag looks perfect.
items.explain: 접속사 that절이 think의 목적어.
